title: feat(app-shell): the page designer can set a list block's object, view and row cap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbP1hty4ZjhhkV5DXp69CBfb)_

Fixes #26703

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:页面设计器里选中「列表视图」(`list-view`)区块时,右侧属性面板新增三个输入框:对象、视图、条数上限。三者都写到区块的 `dataSource` 绑定上(`dataSource.object` / `.view` / `.limit`),中英文标签齐全。
- **为什么改**:宽区域里的列表区块只显示前 `dataSource.limit` 行(没填时 5 行),但设计器以前没有任何地方能改这个数,只能手改页面 JSON。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只加了设计器面板配置和两种语言的标签,不新增任何元数据键,渲染端不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` 新增的 `'list-view'` 一条;`inspectors/PageBlockInspector.listViewRowCap-26703.test.tsx`;`previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` 新增的 `PANEL_WITHOUT_PALETTE` 豁免表。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/PageBlockInspector.listViewRowCap-26703.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿;或在 Studio 打开一个带列表区块的页面,选中它,「条数上限」框里填 12,页面 JSON 出现 `dataSource.limit: 12`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`BLOCK_CONFIG` (the page designer's per-block inspector table) had no `list-view` entry, so selecting a list block showed no typed fields, and "Advanced" lists only keys a block already has. The row cap that PR #26700 made a list block in a wide page region honour (`dataSource.limit`, 5 when unset) could therefore be set only in JSON.

The new entry has three controls, all `at: 'dataSource'`, the binding `ListViewBlock` reads its query from:

| control | writes | kind | why it belongs |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Object / 对象 | `dataSource.object` | object picker | the binding lands it on `objectName` (`ListViewBlock.tsx`, `namesRecordSource`) |
| View / 视图 | `dataSource.view` | text | the saved view the block binds (`compactListDestination`, `element-data-source.ts`) |
| Row limit / 条数上限 | `dataSource.limit` | number, placeholder `5` | the capped list's row count; `5` is its own count when the box is empty |

All three are members of the spec's `ElementDataSourceSchema`, which the schema-parity test (`block-config-schema-parity-8216.test.ts`) judges binding controls against. No new key anywhere, and no `packages/spec/**`, server or plugin-list change.

## Why

A designer who wants a list block on a page to show 10 rows instead of 5 had no control for it. The cap is a key the block already declares and the renderer already honours, so the gap was only the inspector's.

## Tests

- New `PageBlockInspector.listViewRowCap-26703.test.tsx` drives the real inspector on a spec-parsed page: the Row limit box is an editable number input hinting `5`; editing it writes `dataSource.limit` beside the bound object and view, never `properties.limit`; a stored cap, object and view show in their boxes and the View box writes `dataSource.view`; the zh labels render under `zh-CN`.
- `block-config-i18n.test.ts`: the placeholder inventory moves 17 / 6 / 11 → 18 / 6 / 12, and `list-view.limit` joins the literal-value list with its reason.
- `block-config.test.ts`: see the first acceptance note.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): with the entry committed, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` renamed the `'list-view': [` key (anchor 1 → 0, blob `115a5ace` → `20037ca9`) and the new test file ran red, Tests 4 failed (4). Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **The palette does not offer `list-view`.** `block-config.test.ts` pins "a block with a config panel is a block the palette offers", so the new panel needed a decision. Offering the block in the palette is a product change beyond this card, so the case gains `PANEL_WITHOUT_PALETTE`, a one-row exemption with its reason: `list-view` is a public block (`core/src/registry/public-blocks.ts`) that published pages place (`packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-4.0.1-published-pages.artifact.json`), so the panel edits a node a page already carries. A second case keeps the row self-deleting: it goes red when the palette offers the block or the panel goes away. Whether the palette should offer `list-view` is left as an open question in the card report.
- **View is a text box.** The inspector has no saved-view picker kind. A name the object does not have still fails loudly at render (the binding gate's configuration error), as it does for a hand-written one.
- A block that names its object through `data: { provider: 'object', object }` instead of the binding keeps doing so; the Object box shows only `dataSource.object`.
